requiredAttributes.name: service.name
requiredAttributes.description: Stable executable identity such as flaggo-decision-service.

requiredAttributes.name: service.namespace
requiredAttributes.description: Always flaggo for Flaggo-owned service telemetry.

requiredAttributes.name: service.version
requiredAttributes.description: Assembly or Cargo package version of the running service.

requiredAttributes.name: service.instance.id
requiredAttributes.description: One stable identifier for the lifetime of one service process.

optionalAttributes.name: deployment.environment.name
optionalAttributes.description: Operator-defined deployment environment using the standard OpenTelemetry Resource attribute.

scopes.name: flaggo.contract-service
scopes.description: Contract acceptance, reads, Candidate admission, and activation authority.

scopes.name: flaggo.decision-service
scopes.description: Exact-version runtime resolution and deterministic evaluation.

scopes.name: flaggo.otel-ingestion
scopes.description: OTLP request validation, durable append, health, and inbox retention.

scopes.name: flaggo.evidence-materializer
scopes.description: Forward materialization, catalog refresh, checkpoint, backlog, and freshness.

scopes.name: flaggo.async-analysis
scopes.description: Analysis scheduling, claims, evidence cutoffs, agent runs, and Candidate proposals.

attributes.name: flaggo.request.correlation_id
attributes.description: Validated X-Flaggo-Correlation-Id value recorded on request spans and logs.

attributes.name: flaggo.contract.name
attributes.description: Logical DecisionContract name, recorded whenever an operation identifies a contract.

attributes.name: flaggo.contract.digest
attributes.description: Exact immutable contract digest, recorded whenever an operation targets or resolves one version.

attributes.name: flaggo.executable.digest
attributes.description: Exact immutable executable digest when runtime authority is resolved or changed.

attributes.name: flaggo.candidate.digest
attributes.description: Exact Candidate digest when admission or activation identifies a Candidate.

attributes.name: flaggo.activation.superseded_count
attributes.description: Number of pending analysis Candidates made inactive by one activation resolution.

attributes.name: flaggo.batch.id
attributes.description: Raw OTLP Inbox batch identity for one materialization page or diagnostic.

attributes.name: flaggo.analysis.cycle.id
attributes.description: Exact durable analysis-cycle identity.

attributes.name: flaggo.analysis.attempt.id
attributes.description: Exact analysis-agent attempt identity.

attributes.name: flaggo.operation.name
attributes.description: Bounded domain operation name used by operation metrics and spans.

attributes.name: flaggo.operation.outcome
attributes.description: Bounded terminal classification for one operation.

attributes.name: flaggo.failure.category
attributes.description: Bounded failure family. Exact exception messages remain log/span fields rather than metric dimensions.

attributes.name: flaggo.evaluation.source
attributes.description: Bounded source of a successful runtime decision evaluation.

attributes.name: flaggo.otlp.signal
attributes.description: OTLP signal selected by the receiver route.

attributes.name: flaggo.otlp.encoding
attributes.description: Validated OTLP wire encoding.

attributes.name: flaggo.otlp.compression
attributes.description: Validated OTLP transport compression.

attributes.name: flaggo.materializer.item.outcome
attributes.description: Bounded classification for materializer output-item counters.

attributes.name: flaggo.inbox.expired.batch_count
attributes.description: Number of Raw OTLP Inbox batches expired by one retention cycle.

attributes.name: flaggo.inbox.expired.payload_bytes
attributes.description: Raw OTLP Inbox payload bytes expired by one retention cycle.

attributes.name: flaggo.materializer.active_route_count
attributes.description: Active evidence-routing entries in the materializer catalog.

attributes.name: flaggo.materializer.current_contract_count
attributes.description: Current contracts in the materializer catalog.

attributes.name: flaggo.materializer.evidence.conflict_count
attributes.description: Durable evidence conflicts observed at a materializer health snapshot.

attributes.name: flaggo.materializer.evidence.diagnostic_count
attributes.description: Durable evidence diagnostics observed at a materializer health snapshot.

attributes.name: flaggo.materializer.evidence.has_cached_catalog
attributes.description: Whether the evidence store has a durable cached contract catalog.

attributes.name: flaggo.materializer.evidence.observation_count
attributes.description: Durable evidence observations at a materializer health snapshot.

attributes.name: flaggo.materializer.evidence.provenance_count
attributes.description: Durable evidence provenance rows at a materializer health snapshot.

attributes.name: flaggo.materializer.checkpoint_batch_id
attributes.description: Latest Raw OTLP Inbox batch durably checkpointed by the materializer.

attributes.name: flaggo.materializer.pending_batch_count
attributes.description: Raw OTLP Inbox batches pending after a materializer health snapshot.

attributes.name: flaggo.materializer.observed_at
attributes.description: RFC 3339 timestamp for the materializer health snapshot.

attributes.name: flaggo.materializer.oldest_pending_received_at
attributes.description: RFC 3339 receipt time of the oldest pending Raw OTLP Inbox batch.

attributes.name: flaggo.materializer.newest_pending_received_at
attributes.description: RFC 3339 receipt time of the newest pending Raw OTLP Inbox batch.

attributes.name: flaggo.materializer.oldest_pending_age_ms
attributes.description: Age in milliseconds of the oldest pending Raw OTLP Inbox batch.

attributes.name: flaggo.materializer.newest_evidence_observed_at_unix_nano
attributes.description: Unix nanosecond timestamp of the newest materialized evidence, encoded as a decimal string.

attributes.name: flaggo.materializer.evidence_freshness_ms
attributes.description: Age in milliseconds of the newest materialized evidence.

attributes.name: flaggo.materializer.batches_read
attributes.description: Raw OTLP Inbox batches read by one committed materializer page.

attributes.name: flaggo.materializer.conflicts_created
attributes.description: Evidence conflicts created by one committed materializer page.

attributes.name: flaggo.materializer.diagnostics_created
attributes.description: Evidence diagnostics created by one committed materializer page.

attributes.name: flaggo.materializer.duplicate_observations
attributes.description: Duplicate evidence observations seen by one committed materializer page.

attributes.name: flaggo.materializer.observations_created
attributes.description: Evidence observations created by one committed materializer page.

attributes.name: flaggo.materializer.provenance_created
attributes.description: Evidence provenance rows created by one committed materializer page.

attributes.name: flaggo.materializer.catalog_retained
attributes.description: Whether a failed catalog refresh retained a prior valid catalog.

spans.name: flaggo.contract.validate
spans.purpose: Validate one named DecisionContract and compute an exact digest when valid.

spans.name: flaggo.contract.deploy
spans.purpose: Accept or resolve one immutable contract version and ensure its initial executable authority.

spans.name: flaggo.contract.read
spans.purpose: Read current, historical, or exact contract management state.

spans.name: flaggo.candidate.submit
spans.purpose: Validate and admit one analysis-generated Candidate for an exact contract.

spans.name: flaggo.candidate.activate
spans.purpose: Check eligibility and atomically activate one admitted Candidate.

spans.name: flaggo.decision.evaluate
spans.purpose: Resolve and evaluate the active executable for one exact contract version.

spans.name: flaggo.otlp.append
spans.purpose: Validate one OTLP request and durably append it before acknowledgement.

spans.name: flaggo.inbox.retention
spans.purpose: Run one receipt-age and capacity retention maintenance cycle.

spans.name: flaggo.materializer.page
spans.purpose: Read and transactionally commit one forward materialization page.

spans.name: flaggo.materializer.catalog.refresh
spans.purpose: Fetch, validate, and activate one current-contract catalog update.

spans.name: flaggo.analysis.cycle
spans.purpose: Claim and run one evidence-bound analysis cycle for an exact current contract.

logEvents.purpose: Record successful composition-root initialization after required dependencies are ready.
Record the start of graceful service shutdown.
Record completed graceful shutdown immediately before the final bounded telemetry flush.
Record a fatal composition-root failure before process exit.
Record an OTLP request rejected for invalid transport, capacity, or dependency failure.
Record a retention cycle that expired at least one batch.
Record a committed materialization page with aggregate result counts and health.
Record durable activation of a validated current-contract catalog.
Record a failed catalog refresh while retaining the last valid catalog.
Record candidate, no-change, no-candidate, superseded, busy, idle, or not-eligible cycle completion.
Record recoverable or terminal analysis-cycle failure.
Record successful admission of one validated Candidate.
Record explicit invalid, stale, conflict, or failed Candidate admission.
Record successful atomic activation of one executable for an exact contract.
Record stale, invalid, conflicting, unavailable, or failed activation while retaining prior authority.
Record a non-failure Candidate rejection, supersession, or optimistic-concurrency yield.
Record a failed paced activation scan before one Candidate can be resolved.

metrics.name: flaggo.contract.operations
metrics.purpose: Count bounded Contract Service domain operations by operation and outcome.

metrics.name: flaggo.contract.operation.duration
metrics.purpose: Measure Contract Service domain-operation latency.

metrics.name: flaggo.decision.evaluations
metrics.purpose: Count runtime evaluations by bounded outcome.

metrics.name: flaggo.decision.evaluation.duration
metrics.purpose: Measure exact-version runtime evaluation latency.

metrics.name: flaggo.otlp.requests
metrics.purpose: Count accepted and rejected OTLP requests by bounded transport facts and outcome.

metrics.name: flaggo.otlp.request.size
metrics.purpose: Measure decompressed OTLP request payload size.

metrics.name: flaggo.inbox.retained.batches
metrics.purpose: Current retained Raw OTLP Inbox batch count.

metrics.name: flaggo.inbox.retained.bytes
metrics.purpose: Current retained Raw OTLP Inbox payload bytes.

metrics.name: flaggo.inbox.oldest.age
metrics.purpose: Age of the oldest retained Raw OTLP Inbox batch.

metrics.name: flaggo.inbox.expired.batches
metrics.purpose: Cumulative batches expired by inbox retention.

metrics.name: flaggo.inbox.expired.bytes
metrics.purpose: Cumulative payload bytes expired by inbox retention.

metrics.name: flaggo.materializer.pages
metrics.purpose: Count materializer polling/page outcomes.

metrics.name: flaggo.materializer.page.duration
metrics.purpose: Measure one materializer page attempt.

metrics.name: flaggo.materializer.pending.batches
metrics.purpose: Current Raw OTLP Inbox batches pending after the materializer checkpoint.

metrics.name: flaggo.materializer.oldest_pending.age
metrics.purpose: Age of the oldest pending batch after the materializer checkpoint.

metrics.name: flaggo.materializer.evidence.freshness
metrics.purpose: Age of the newest materialized Evidence Store observation.

metrics.name: flaggo.materializer.items
metrics.purpose: Count created, duplicate, conflict, diagnostic, and provenance results.

metrics.name: flaggo.analysis.cycles
metrics.purpose: Count bounded analysis coordinator outcomes.

metrics.name: flaggo.analysis.cycle.duration
metrics.purpose: Measure active analysis-cycle duration.

metrics.name: flaggo.analysis.workers.active
metrics.purpose: Current number of workers actively running an analysis attempt.

metrics.name: flaggo.candidate.submissions
metrics.purpose: Count Candidate submission outcomes without Candidate or contract identifiers.

metrics.name: flaggo.activation.attempts
metrics.purpose: Count Candidate activation outcomes without Candidate, executable, or contract identifiers.
